title: 第29章
content:
马寻的生活非常充实，基本上都是早上八点多起床，洗漱后就在书房里研究一些东西。整理资料、各种头绪，他想要研究颗粒化火药、改善火器，想要研究土法抗生素、想要提纯酒精等等，这都是在忙的事情。只是暂时没有太多的办法，以后少不了需要用心研究，需要花大价钱才能取得一点成绩。吃过午饭就去城外，带着常茂等人练习骑术，慢慢的也有些进步，基本可以骑马小跑了。练习骑术之后就去军营，在沐英的陪伴下初步的去了解军中的一些常识，比如说军队的人数、武器配备，将兵体系等等。这样的生活非常充实，算得上是富贵闲人了。傍晚时分，马寻开口说道，“沐英，兵法：一曰度，二曰量，三曰数，四曰称，五曰胜。地生度，度生量，量生数，数生称，称生胜。”沐英就耐心听着，这是《孙子兵法》中的《军型篇》。马寻继续问道，“我就是不太明白，这强军、弱军，除了该从军械等看出来，还该从哪看出来？”沐英仔细想了想之后说道，“舅舅，我现在该不该知道这些？”马寻放慢骑马的速度，说道，“都到这了，你觉得你该知道吗？”沐英立刻恍然大悟，连忙说道，“那我就才疏学浅了，我不明白。御史中丞知兵，他家二公子也知兵，我们登门讨教如何？”马寻笑的非常开心，随即说道，“以后隔两天你不明白一趟，我们就去御史中丞家讨教。所谓温故知新，对你也有好处。”沐英忍着笑，虽然他的岁数稍微大一点，但是在马寻面前也从来都是以小辈自居。而和马寻相处，沐英也从未觉得这个舅舅盛气凌人。刘伯温府邸的护卫都麻木了，远远的就看到了国舅爷，这是又要来登门讨教了。所谓恶客临门，这是不能拒绝的恶客。在家看书的刘琏、刘璟兄弟两个也都麻木了，急匆匆的到了正厅招待贵客。沐英喝了口茶，说道，“我家沐春闹的厉害，我先回去了。”刘琏也没了耐心，说道，“我一直不太了解兵法，二弟你与国舅爷好生探讨。”作为刘伯温的次子，刘璟璟自小好学，通诸经、喜谈兵、究韬略，历史上的他也曾随唐胜宗镇压起义。在靖难之役之中向李景隆献策十六条，可惜一条都没被采纳。然后就是辞官归隐，在朱棣称帝后，被捉拿回京的刘璟依然称朱棣为‘殿下’，直接明言朱棣是篡位，结果在狱中自缢。等到其他人走后，刘璟笑着看向马寻，“国舅，现在还该继续探讨兵法？”“探讨啊，我现在心里怕的厉害。”

马寻抱怨说道，“陛下可能要派我出去练兵，我这本事哪够练兵。”刘璟安慰说道，“国舅无须担心，若是您去练兵，必然佐以精兵强将。只要国舅虚心纳谏，肯定能练好兵。”马寻明白了，“我只要不瞎说话，让手底下的人去练兵就好？”刘璟笑而不语，这位国舅爷有没有军事能力、有没有天赋，大家都心知肚明。马寻看向刘璟问道，“你现在还是白衣吧？要是陛下让我去练兵，我能不能把你也带着？我看你是有才学的，跟着我去练兵如何？”刘璟心动，只是有些为难，“国舅，朝中将帅如云，我才疏学浅哪能有本事去军中。”刘璟才二十呢，正是青春年少之时，心里怎么可能不热血呢。无非就是他也知道自己的父亲被皇帝嫌弃，而且他这样浙东系的出身，在军中更是毫无地位。说话间，刘姝宁端着茶过来了，“二哥，请用茶。国舅，请用茶。”刘璟瞪了一眼自家妹妹，还要不要礼数了？马寻笑盈盈的接过茶，看着刘姝宁说道，“昨天我记得让婉儿来让你誊抄些医书，可写好了？”刘璟更加看不下去了，这位国舅爷有礼数，但是真的不多。哪能说话的时候盯着女子的眼睛，这也太唐突了。而且国舅爷的心思就是司马昭之心路人皆知，不是自己来府里，就是让常家的嫡女打着各种旗号过来。还没定亲呢，就算是定亲了也不该如此！刘姝宁抿嘴说道，“自然是誊抄好了，只是其他人也能做的。”“那不同，这些事情我只放心自家人去做。”马寻就说道，“那些东西你也能猜出来一二，和气疾有关。”刘璟、刘姝宁不说话了，皇后、太子有气疾，这也不是秘密了。就在说话间，一声咳嗽传来，板着脸的小老头刘伯温闪亮登场。毛脚女婿见了老丈人有些胆怯，马寻立刻说道，“既然和二哥商讨完兵法，你也誊抄好了医书，我就告辞了。御史中丞，下回再见。”刘伯温微微点头，他不敢客气说句留下用饭，因为这位国舅爷到时候真的会不客气的留下来。看着马寻狼狈逃窜的背影，刘伯温不高兴的冷哼一声。再看看捂嘴在笑的女儿，刘伯温的心情更加不好了，还没嫁出去呢！在武英殿里，朱元璋纳闷了，“小弟是真不拿咱们当自家人，不召见他就从不进宫。”
content_en:
Ma Xun's life is very fulfilling. He usually wakes up at around eight o'clock in the morning, studies something in the study after washing.He is sorting through information and various clues. He wants to study granulated gunpowder, improve firearms, study indigenous antibiotics, purify alcohol, etc. These are all busy things.It's just that there aren't many solutions for the time being. In the future, it will inevitably require careful research and spending a lot of money to achieve some results.After lunch, we went outside the city and took Chang Mao and others to practice riding. They gradually made some progress and were basically able to ride a horse and trot.After practicing riding skills, I went to the military camp. Accompanied by Mu Ying, I initially learned about some common sense in the army, such as the number of people in the army, weapons and equipment, the general system, etc.Such a life is very fulfilling, and one can be regarded as a wealthy and idle person.In the evening, Ma Xun said, "Mu Ying, the art of war: the first is measurement, the second is measurement, the third is counting, the fourth is weighing, and the fifth is victory. The ground produces measurement, measurement produces quantity, measurement produces number, counting produces measurement, and measurement produces victory." Mu Ying listened patiently. This was the "Military Form Chapter" in "The Art of War" by Sun Tzu.Ma Xun continued to ask, "I just don't quite understand. Apart from ordnance, how can we tell whether a strong army or a weak army is strong?" Mu Ying thought about it carefully and said, "Uncle, should I know this now?" Ma Xun slowed down his horse riding speed and said, "We're here now, do you think you should know?" Mu Ying suddenly understood, and said quickly, "Then I'm just ignorant."I don't understand. The censor Zhongcheng knows the army, and his second son also knows the army. How about we come to ask for advice?"Ma Xun smiled very happily, and then said, "If you don't understand, we will go to the censor Zhongcheng's house for advice. The so-called review of the past and learning the new will be good for you."Mu Ying suppressed a smile. Although he was a little older, he always regarded himself as a junior in front of Ma Xun.When getting along with Ma Xun, Mu Ying never felt that this uncle was domineering.The guards at Liu Bowen's residence were numb. They saw Uncle Guo from a distance, and they were coming to ask for advice again.The so-called bad guest comes to the door. This is a bad guest that cannot be refused.Brothers Liu Lian and Liu Jing, who were reading at home, were also numb and hurried to the main hall to entertain the distinguished guests.Mu Ying took a sip of tea and said, "My family Mu Chun is making a big fuss, so I'm going back first." Liu Lian lost his patience and said, "I have never understood the art of war. Second brother, you and my uncle will have a good time discussing it." As the second son of Liu Bowen, Liu Jingjing was eager to learn since he was a child. He was familiar with the classics, liked to talk about war, and studied strategy. In history, he also followed Tang Shengzong to suppress uprisings.During the Battle of Jingnan, he offered sixteen suggestions to Li Jinglong, but unfortunately none of them were adopted.Then he resigned and went into seclusion. After Zhu Di proclaimed himself emperor, Liu Jing, who was captured and returned to Beijing, still called Zhu Di "Your Highness" and directly stated that Zhu Di had usurped the throne. As a result, he hanged himself in prison.After the others left, Liu Jing looked at Ma Xun with a smile, "Uncle Guo, should we continue to discuss the art of war now?" "Discuss it, I am very scared now."

Ma Xun complained, "Your Majesty may want to send me out to train troops. I am not good enough to train troops." Liu Jing comforted him and said, "Uncle, there is no need to worry. If you go to train troops, you will be supported by elite soldiers and strong generals. As long as uncle accepts advice humbly,I can definitely train soldiers well." Ma Xun understood, "As long as I don't talk nonsense, let the people under my command train the soldiers?" Liu Jing smiled and said nothing. Everyone knew whether this uncle had military ability and talent.Ma Xun looked at Liu Jing and asked, "You are still in white, right? If His Majesty asks me to go to the army for training, can I take you with me? I think you are talented and learned, how about you train with me?" Liu Jing was moved, but he was a little embarrassed, "Uncle, the generals in the court are like clouds, how can I go to the army because I am not talented and knowledgeable." Liu Jing was only twenty. When he was young, how could he not be passionate in his heart.It's just that he also knew that his father was despised by the emperor, and since he was from the eastern Zhejiang clan, he had no status in the army.While talking, Liu Shuning came over with tea, "Second brother, please have tea. Uncle Guo, please have tea." Liu Jing glared at her sister, do you still need some etiquette?Ma Xun took the tea with a smile, looked at Liu Shuning and said, "Yesterday I remembered to ask Wan'er to let you copy some medical books, have you finished writing them?" Liu Jing couldn't stand it anymore. This uncle-in-law was polite, but he really didn't have much.How could he stare into the woman's eyes while speaking? It would be too abrupt.Moreover, Uncle Guo's thoughts were known to everyone on the road, so he either came to the house himself or asked the Chang family's legitimate daughter to come under various banners.You haven’t gotten engaged yet, but you shouldn’t do this even if you are engaged!Liu Shuning pursed her lips and said, "Of course I have copied it, but others can do it." "That's different. I only trust my own family to do these things." Ma Xun said, "You can guess a thing or two about those things, and they are related to qi disease." Liu Jing and Liu Shuning stopped talking. It is no secret that the queen and the prince have qi disease.Just as he was talking, a cough came, and the stern-faced little old man Liu Bowen made his appearance.The hairy-footed son-in-law was a little timid when he saw his father-in-law. Ma Xun immediately said, "Now that I have discussed the art of war with my second brother and you have copied the medical books, I will take my leave. Censor Zhongcheng, see you next time." Liu Bowen nodded slightly. He did not dare to politely say that he would stay for dinner, because the uncle of the country would really stay without courtesy.Seeing Ma Xun's running figure in embarrassment, Liu Bowen snorted unhappily.Looking at his daughter who was covering her mouth and laughing, Liu Bowen was in an even worse mood. She wasn't married yet!In the Wuying Palace, Zhu Yuanzhang was puzzled, "My younger brother really doesn't regard us as his own family. He never enters the palace unless he is summoned."
